ops.body:
Acknowledged the root scheduling directive: component draft PRs and CI start as each final branch becomes coherent, not after all cc-sync E2E and the cross-repo review.
- synckit: the PR workflow launches the moment the final-merge Run wf_1a000879-e5b completes.
- reposync: the PR workflow launches the moment the final-merge Run wf_85b9ef10-cc7 completes.
- Both PR workflows: a codex/astra prose lane writes the title and body from `ccx vcs guidelines` + writing-docs; then `ccx vcs ship --no-commit --draft --pr-title ... --pr-body-file ...` (a body is always present); CI is watched to green, with mechanical failures fixed forward.
- cc-sync: a draft PR as soon as phase 2a (Run wf_ce100eb1-460) lands a coherent build. go.mod pins pseudo-versions of the pushed synckit/reposync final branch commits so CI builds without the uncommitted go.work; it is re-pinned to releases later. E2E commits land on the PR afterwards.
- Orca: a DRAFT PR from yasyf/orca:cc-sync/cross-machine-recovery to stablyai/orca:main, following Orca's .github/pull_request_template.md, including the Visual Proof section from the orca-finish QA screenshots. It opens right after the orca-finish QA (Run wf_1a8cd60d-b5c) and is never auto-merged.
- Release tags (synckit v0.40.0, reposync v0.31.0, cc-sync v0.1.0) come only after the PRs merge; release secrets remain an external gate for cc-sync.
